title: Hold a plumbing licence
what: Do plumbing and drainage work only under an endorsed contractor licence or supervisor certificate, or under the immediate supervision of a holder.

sources.title: Plumbing and Drainage Act 2011 (NSW)
sources.publisher: NSW Legislation (via the Open Australian Legal Corpus)
sources.quote: A person must not do any kind of plumbing and drainage work unless the person— (a) holds an endorsed contractor licence or a supervisor certificate in force under the Home Building Act 1989 authorising the holder to do that kind of work,
